aneurysm_neck.en_desc: The contiguous run proximal to the sac whose equivalent diameter stays below 1.2 × the reference diameter; the few-millimetre shoulder between neck and sac belongs to neither.
aneurysm_neck.zh_desc: 瘤体近端、等效直径 < 1.2 × 参考直径的连续区段；瘤体与瘤颈之间常有几毫米过渡肩部，不计入两者。

aneurysm_sac.en_desc: The contiguous run of stations whose equivalent diameter is at least 1.5 × the reference diameter (the usual AAA definition); its volume is the trapezoidal integral of section area along the arc length and is overestimated where a section is oblique.
aneurysm_sac.zh_desc: 等效直径 ≥ 1.5 × 参考直径的连续区段（AAA 常用定义）；体积按截面面积沿弧长梯形积分，斜切站会偏大。

arc_distance.en_desc: Arc length between the two points projected onto the centreline; across branches it is summed along the tree via the common ancestor.
arc_distance.zh_desc: 两点投影到中心线后的弧长距离；跨分支时沿分支树经公共祖先求和。

area_fraction.en_desc: Share of prediction points below/above a threshold multiplied by the input wall area; an estimate, not an exact surface integral.
area_fraction.zh_desc: 低 / 高 / 极高 WSS 的点数占比乘以输入壁面面积，是估计值，不是三角面精确积分。

area_weighted_p99.en_desc: 99th percentile of WSS interpolated onto the STL triangles, weighted by triangle area; computed only on fully covered triangles.
area_weighted_p99.zh_desc: 把插值到 STL 三角面上的 WSS 按三角面面积加权后取的 99% 分位；只在插值完全覆盖的三角面上统计。

confidence_proxy.en_desc: Combined score of the automatic outlet naming (left/right and internal/external weights); not a prediction error. Automatic routing needs ≥ 0.95 and a validated gate.
confidence_proxy.zh_desc: 出口自动命名的综合分数（左右、内外四项加权），不是预测误差；≥ 0.95 且门控校准通过才自动放行。

delta_p.en_desc: Mean pressure of interior points in the proximal 10 % arc-length segment minus that of the distal 10 % segment.
delta_p.zh_desc: 分支近端 10% 与远端 10% 弧长段内部点的平均压力之差（近端 − 远端）。

equivalent_diameter.en_desc: Diameter of the circle with the same cross-sectional area, 2·sqrt(area/π); more robust to oblique cuts and contour shape than the maximum Feret diameter.
equivalent_diameter.zh_desc: 与截面面积相同的圆的直径，2·sqrt(面积/π)；比最大 Feret 直径对斜切和轮廓形状更稳健。

feature_contract.en_desc: Source hash of the frozen feature library wss_features; a release declaring a different hash is refused.
feature_contract.zh_desc: 冻结特征库 wss_features 的源码哈希；不一致的发布包会被拒绝加载。

finding_decision.en_desc: The reviewer confirms or rejects each automatic finding with a note; rejected items leave the one-page body and go to the appendix.
finding_decision.zh_desc: 审阅人对每条自动发现标记确认或驳回并备注；驳回项不进一页纸正文，只列附录。

fixed_frame.en_desc: Every prediction refers to the single phase at step 1162 (≈ 0.21 s); it is not a full-cycle result.
fixed_frame.zh_desc: 所有预测对应 step 1162（约 0.21 s）的单一时相，不是全周期结果。

gaussian_interpolation.en_desc: Vertex colours and hover values are a σ = 0.5 mm Gaussian interpolation; statistics stay on the prediction cloud.
gaussian_interpolation.zh_desc: 三维报告的顶点颜色与鼠标读值是 σ = 0.5 mm 的 Gaussian 插值；统计仍在预测点云上计算。

local_diameter.en_desc: Twice the centreline inscribed radius, not the largest diameter of the cross-section at that point.
local_diameter.zh_desc: 中心线内切半径的两倍，不是该点截面的最大直径。

lumen_volume.en_desc: Volume enclosed by the wall mesh after each opening is fan-capped at its centroid (divergence theorem); it depends on where the input STL was cut and is not an anatomical vessel volume.
lumen_volume.zh_desc: 壁面网格把每个开口用扇形封盖后按散度定理求得的封闭体积；随输入 STL 的切口位置变化，不是解剖学血管容积。

max.en_desc: Largest single-point WSS in the prediction cloud, shown as a reference with its location; not the same statistic as p99.
max.zh_desc: 预测点云上的单点最大 WSS，仅作参考并标出位置；与 p99 不是同一统计量。

max_diameter.en_desc: At stations 1 mm apart the wall mesh is cut perpendicular to the centreline; the value is the largest distance between two points of that contour (maximum Feret diameter), not the inscribed diameter.
max_diameter.zh_desc: 中心线每 1 mm 取一站，用局部切线为法向切壁面网格得到管腔轮廓，取轮廓上最远两点的距离（最大 Feret 直径）；不是中心线内切直径。

mean.en_desc: Equal-weight average WSS over the prediction points.
mean.zh_desc: 预测点云上的等权平均 WSS。

narrative.en_desc: A sentence-level restatement of the numbers already on this page; it states only quantities that exist and contains no diagnosis. A reviewer may replace it, in which case the text is marked as edited.
narrative.zh_desc: 由本页已有数字自动组织的中文描述，只陈述存在的量，不含诊断判断；审阅人可改写，改写后标「审阅人已修改」。

p99.en_desc: 99th percentile of WSS over the prediction point cloud; the primary peak metric, more stable than the maximum.
p99.zh_desc: 预测点云上 99% 分位的 WSS，作为主峰值指标；比最大值稳定，不受个别离群点影响。

population_percentile.en_desc: Position of this case's p99 within the out-of-fold p99 distribution of the 136-case training cohort; the reference comes from model predictions, not CFD.
population_percentile.zh_desc: 本例 p99 在 136 例训练队列折外预测 p99 分布中的位置；参照来自模型折外预测，不是 CFD。

quality_grade.en_desc: A/B/C grade from seed dispersion and geometry-range checks; a confidence hint, not a correction.
quality_grade.zh_desc: 按 seed 间离散度与几何范围检查给出的 A/B/C 等级，只提示可信程度，不改数值。

reference_diameter.en_desc: 10th percentile of the equivalent diameter over all closed aortic stations, a robust estimate of this case's normal calibre; both the sac and the neck criteria are relative to it.
reference_diameter.zh_desc: 主动脉全部闭合截面等效直径的第 10 百分位，作为该病例「正常管径」的稳健估计；瘤体与瘤颈判据都以它为基准。

relative_pressure.en_desc: Predicted pressure minus the volume-mean pressure of the peak frame; absolute blood pressure cannot be recovered, use it for differences only.
relative_pressure.zh_desc: 预测压力减去当前峰值帧体积平均压力；不能恢复绝对血压，只用于比较压差。

release.en_desc: Frozen weights plus inference contract (e.g. X5D_v51_5seed_20260916); a job is bound to one release and reruns never overwrite history.
release.zh_desc: 冻结的权重与推理合同目录（如 X5D_v51_5seed_20260916）；任务固定绑定，重跑不覆盖历史结果。

review_status.en_desc: Unreviewed / reviewed (locked: no recomputation, outlet change or deletion) / reopened.
review_status.zh_desc: 未审阅 / 已审阅（锁定：不能重算、改出口或删除）/ 已重新打开。

run_identity.en_desc: Stable hash of the input SHA256, release fingerprint, outlet mapping and inference parameters; used for same-case comparison and reproduction.
run_identity.zh_desc: 由输入 SHA256、发布包指纹、出口映射与推理参数决定的稳定哈希，用于同病例比较与复现。

slice.en_desc: A finite-thickness slab of prediction points; the 2-D map uses local IDW colouring and stays grey where coverage is insufficient.
slice.zh_desc: 有限厚度的预测点云切片，二维图用局部 IDW 着色，覆盖不足处留灰。

speed.en_desc: Magnitude of the ensemble velocity vector, predicted on interior points only; the zero wall velocity is not displayed.
speed.zh_desc: 三 seed 集成速度向量的模长，只在内部点上预测；壁面速度为零不展示。

standard_views.en_desc: Front/back/left/right/top/bottom follow the inferred anatomical frame (x = patient left, z = towards the inlet); verify left/right when the STL carries no patient orientation.
standard_views.zh_desc: 前 / 后 / 左 / 右 / 上 / 下按解剖坐标架推断（x = 患者左，z = 指向入口）；STL 无患者方向时请核对左右。

streamlines.en_desc: Steady streamlines of the fixed systolic-frame velocity, integrated both ways through local IDW interpolation; not time-evolving particle paths.
streamlines.zh_desc: 固定收缩期帧速度场的稳态流线，由局部 IDW 插值双向积分；不是随时间演化的粒子轨迹。

thresholds.en_desc: Low WSS < 0.4 Pa, high > 4 Pa, very high > 7 Pa; editable in the report, area fractions are recomputed on the fly.
thresholds.zh_desc: 低 WSS < 0.4 Pa、高 WSS > 4 Pa、极高 WSS > 7 Pa；报告里可改，面积占比即时重算，不改 summary.json。

tortuosity.en_desc: Centreline arc length of a branch divided by the straight distance between its ends; 1.0 is straight and larger values are more tortuous.
tortuosity.zh_desc: 分支中心线弧长除以两端直线距离；1.0 为笔直，越大越迂曲。

trust_geometry_out_of_range.en: Trust bit: geometry out of range
trust_geometry_out_of_range.en_desc: Branch radius or length outside the training cohort range (0.9×min–1.1×max of the train136 atlas).
trust_geometry_out_of_range.zh_desc: 分支半径或长度超出训练队列范围（train136 atlas 的 0.9×min–1.1×max）。

trust_interpolation_uncovered.en_desc: Vertices with no prediction point within 1.5 mm of the Gaussian kernel; shown grey, never extrapolated.
trust_interpolation_uncovered.zh_desc: Gaussian 插值 1.5 mm 内没有预测点的顶点，显示为灰色，不外推。

trust_low_sample_support.en_desc: Interior points whose 8-neighbour radius exceeds twice the global median; the volume is sparsely sampled there.
trust_low_sample_support.zh_desc: 内部点 8 近邻半径超过全局中位数的两倍，该处体场采样稀疏。

trust_near_opening.en_desc: Closer than two opening radii to the nearest inlet/outlet cut; boundary conditions dominate there.
trust_near_opening.zh_desc: 距最近切口中心小于两倍切口半径；入口 / 出口边界条件影响较大。

trust_rough_surface.en_desc: Regions whose local PCA surface variation exceeds 0.02; segmentation noise may affect the prediction.
trust_rough_surface.zh_desc: 局部 PCA 表面变化率 > 0.02 的区域，分割噪声可能影响预测。
